Design Career Guide by Elvis Obi

name: Design Career Guide by Elvis Obi
summary: Google Doc listing design career resources: books, apps, websites, jobs, toolkits, design tools and design systems.
description: A shared 2022 document by Elvis Obi and Emmanuel Adegbe collecting resources for people building a design career: books (Refactoring UI, The Design of Everyday Things, Don't Make Me Think), apps (UX Companion, Uxcel), practice websites (Laws of UX, the method.ac series, Coolors, Mobbin, Screenlane), job boards, toolkits, design tools, design systems, portfolio builders and mentorship categories.
contains: sections: Books, Apps, Websites, Jobs, ToolKits, Design Tools, Design Systems
books: Refactoring UI, Think like a UX Researcher, The Design of Everyday Things, Don't Make Me Think
apps: UX Companion and Uxcel on Google Play and the App Store
websites: Laws of UX, Coolors, Awwwards, Dribbble, Behance, Mobbin, Screenlane
